cards.title: Your round 11 notes
cards.text: The Laser swings round slowly and builds up while held. Deaths hit much harder. Small polish.
cards.why: Everything from the last deck. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.15.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

parts.title: Laser
parts.text: Turns toward your aim at a limited speed, so sweeping it takes time. Starts at 30% and builds to full over 1.2 s held, getting wider too.

parts.title: Deaths
parts.text: A white pop, the body flung hard and spinning, broken bits of its shape, more sparks, a small shake, and a few frames' freeze.

parts.title: Small polish
parts.text: A small muzzle flash, short tails on bolts, enemies grow in when they arrive, XP pickups pop.
